Question
========
A sociologist wants to examine whether there is a relationship between level of education (measured in years) and annual income (in dollars) among adults in the U.S. Which statistical test is most appropriate?


Answerlist
----------

* Pearson’s correlation (r)

* t-test

* Chi-square test

* Logistic regression
